Looking after your new lawn

New turf needs regular watering for the first few weeks, especially in warm or dry weather. Try to keep off it while the roots establish, and leave the first cut until the grass has taken hold. We will give you simple aftercare tips when we finish.

Turf, patio and fencing together

Many of our customers combine new turf with a patio or new fencing. It is a great way to get a complete, finished garden in one go, with one team and less disruption. Patios · Fencing

Turfing FAQs

When is the best time to lay turf?

Turf can be laid for much of the year, but spring and autumn are usually best, as the weather is mild and the ground is moist. We will advise on timing for your garden.

How soon can I use my new lawn?

Give it a few weeks to root before regular use [PLACEHOLDER: confirm your lawn aftercare advice]. We will give you aftercare tips on the day.

Can you turf the garden and lay a patio at the same time?

Yes. We can do both as one project.
